text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and B at gains felt rewarding, but I should not let that satisfaction rush me into selling; decide based on each stock’s outlook and portfolio needs.","I sold Stock E and C at large losses after holding them, and bought more Stock A. I should avoid letting loss aversion or reluctance to admit a mistake keep me holding a weak position—or prompt a purchase without a clear rationale.","I traded infrequently, which helped me avoid impulsive moves, but I should still review my holdings periodically and act when the evidence changes."]}
